catalysts.headline: Corning enters $2B at-the-market equity offering agreement with Goldman Sachs; no fixed price or share count disclosed
catalysts.impact: Stock closed down 13.70% on the session; sympathy weakness also hit optical/AI-supply-chain peers (Coherent -11%, Lumentum -9%, Fabrinet -6%)

catalysts.headline: Corning entered an Equity Distribution Agreement with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC to sell up to $2,000,000,000 of common stock at-the-market under its existing Form S-3 shelf, with proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes (capex, optical-capacity investment, debt reduction, dividends). Goldman receives a 1% commission on gross proceeds; no fixed price or share count was set.
catalysts.impact: Shares fell sharply on the news (reports range from -12% to -13.6%, one calling it the worst S&P 500 performer that day) — see conflicts

catalysts.headline: Corning reported Q2 2026 results (non-GAAP EPS $0.78, beating consensus) and issued Q3 2026 guidance of core sales $4.9-5.0B and core EPS $0.85-0.89; Optical Communications sales reportedly rose sharply on generative-AI infrastructure demand (Enterprise Networks segment up as much as 65% per one source).
catalysts.impact: Stock reaction disagreed across sources: -2.5% in one report, -11.2% in another, both attributed to Q3 guidance concerns

conflicts: Market cap/share price keeps diverging by source and date: $137.28B at $159.37 (Google Finance, 2026-10-05) vs $116.42B at implied ~$135/share (MarketBeat, 2026-10-21) vs $131.21B at $152.45 (equibles, 2026-08-19, on file) vs an undated TipRanks figure of only $75.02B at 857.36M shares. The Oct-21 MarketBeat figure is the most recent dated point but is far below the Oct-5 figure just 16 days earlier, which is a larger swing than typical trading would explain and could not be reconciled with a single confirmed daily closing price this session.

Possible reverse-split-scale flag: none of the above look impossible relative to each other (all in the $130-$160/share range), so no split is suspected -- but the $75.02B/857.36M-share TipRanks figure (implying ~$87/share) is far enough outside this band that it was excluded as unreliable rather than treated as a genuine current reading.
notes: Could not confirm cash, debt, or a single reconciled market cap this session. Q3 2026 earnings date (Oct 27) is now corroborated across multiple earnings-calendar sites, versus 'unknown' previously on file, though still not a company-confirmed date.
